facts.text: I want cleaning routines or schedules that align with my daily activities.
I want cleaning routines to help promote a calmer and more organized home.
I lose steam after a few days when I start cleaning with a lot of enthusiasm.
I like the idea of rewarding myself after finishing a cleaning task.
I want to treat myself to a bubble bath after finishing a cleaning task.
I want to treat myself to ice cream after finishing a cleaning task.
I plan to reward myself with a shopping spree if I stick to my cleaning routines for a whole month.
Sometimes I do not feel like cleaning.

keyphrases: lose steam after a few days
stick to routines for a month
push through days you don't feel like cleaning
